messages:
priya: quick sync — we have a new model entering the intake: mosaic-13b-quant. need to lock QA/regression gates before any canary. pinging @maria @aj @sam :wave:
maria: ack. what are the minimal suites we want run for bring-up? core_qa, summarization, embeddings smoke? :thinking_face:
aj: core_qa + instruction-following + toxic-safety smoke. embeddings smoke for retrieval-sensitive customers. keep suite small for initial canary (~2k examples).
sam: agree. also include a small adversarial prompt set from last regression (the one that caught hallucination spike).
priya: proposed pass/fail thresholds for canary: "qa_f1_drop" <= 2.0 (absolute), "rouge_l_drop" <= 1.0, "embed_sim" >= 0.92, hallucination incidents not > 1.5x baseline, latency p95 <= 320ms. thoughts?
maria: thresholds look reasonable. lower the p95 to 300ms if we want stricter SLO on hosted. If it fails latency but passes quality, we can route to dedicated.
aj: noted. for quantization profiles we should test q8 and q4hf if supported; failure in q4hf should fall back automatically to q8 in canary policy.
priya: good call. ownership: aj runs the harness + local smoke, sam curates adversarial prompts, maria will update canary rollout policy. I will draft the gate doc.
aj: running a quick harness now. command: ```./harness/run_eval.py --model mosaic-13b-quant --suites core_qa,summarization,embeddings --sample 2000 --retries 1 --profile q8```
eval-bot: auto-report: baseline vs mosaic-13b-quant(q8): qa_f1 delta -1.6, rouge_l delta -0.7, embed_sim 0.925, hallucination_count +12%, latency p95 +28ms. full logs: https://internal/evals/2223334444
sam: hm hallucination +12% is concerning. but embed_sim okay and qa_f1 within 2.0. may still pass with mitigation (prompt tweaks + reranking).
maria: agree. proposal: pass canary with 48h observation window and rollback if hallucination incidents exceed +10% relative. also enable fallback to fp16 variant if hallucination patterns persist.
priya: updated gate doc draft: - gate_status: conditional_pass - mitigations_required: [prompt-templates adjustment, reranker threshold change] - observation_window: 48h - rollback_condition: hallucination > +10% or qa_f1 drop >2.0 absolute. I'll paste doc in #eng-ml-post later.
aj: quick note — ensure eval harness records prompt templates used. sometimes mitigations alter comparability.
sam: i'll attach the adversarial set and a short checklist for manual spot checks.
eval-bot: smoke-run artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/mosaic-13b-quant/2223334444/artifacts.zip
maria: :+1: I'll update canary policy to include automated fallback to q8->fp16 path and set the routing policy for low-latency customers.
priya: ok team — next steps: aj run full reduced-retry harness with q4hf and q8, sam finish adversarial set, maria publish canary policy, I’ll own the gate doc + announce. aim to start canary tomorrow 09:00 PT.
aj: on it, starting q4hf now. will post results here.
priya: thanks. tagging this thread as the single source for decisions. keep messages short here so the post can be copy/pasted into the onboarding checklist. :memo:
